summary: No new receipt this turn, so I corrected the account and requested the last repeat. The correction: my consolidated summary claimed only a snapshot install or an operator restart repairs a stale configuration, but reading the append path shows appendEntries processes new configuration entries and installs the membership they encode (raft.go 1569-1578 via processConfigurationLogEntry), so a later configuration change also repairs the node — the three repair paths are now stated explicitly, with the note that in the empty-configuration cases the first two repairs need a leader, which is precisely what the empty configuration prevents. The limitation records that this narrows the persistence claim without changing any comparison or receipt. I then requested one repeat of the partial-restart experiment, since that harness carries the timing-dependent half of the progress claim (which node leads after two of three voters restart) alongside the structural half (a live quorum that cannot elect once the configured voter stops).
